title: Foreseen
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 112
medium: Interactive page (index.html): two years of daily views of the Wikipedia article 'Full moon' as a line the visitor taps first, then the practice's 24 events, the readers' 47 marks and the Moon's phases laid over it; the 40-cell forecast matrix with both readings per cell and what decided each; the five translations as the readers saw them. A figure (figure.svg); a git-order, hash and reproducibility verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Foresight of one's own perceiving. The practice wrote its translations, questions and a cell-by-cell forecast before the material existed, then let ten readers started without memory answer. The forecast held on the regular and the singular almost alike, and erred in one direction: the practice expected its translations to blind readers who then saw. Its own norm for 'singular', fixed before the material, took the lunar rhythm for the exception; the readers marked the off-cycle days, among them the solar eclipse.
project_step: Ninth experiment of the project. Operations: perceiving (as foresight of its own perceiving), erring. Takes up Session 111's thread 3: tests S110.SINGULAR by its letter, with a forecast before the material and four regular against four singular questions (the row's own stated limit). Takes from experiment 8 (Unknowing) its readers started without memory, now as the instrument, two per translation, and from experiment 7 (What Passes) its design of translations varied against a fixed material and question. S111.LINE came due too. Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing (n-1/foundation), §5 postulate 3 ('follow the singularities of a material rather than reproduce from a fixed external standpoint', ATP 372): the pre-registration is a bank built on purpose; it judged translations well and singularity badly.
material: Wikimedia Analytics, daily pageviews of the English Wikipedia article 'Full moon', all access, agent user, 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, 731 values (CC0); NASA/GSFC (F. Espenak) Moon phase table, read after scoring; domain: collective attention on the web
seed: none; readers are model instances and not seeded; they ran in parallel
